alt: 大片普通幼苗之間，只有一株珍稀蘭花被細心保護在玻璃罩裡，兩人珍惜地欣賞。
scene_prompt: In a community conservation greenhouse, almost all the nursery trays contain ordinary small green seedlings, while one single extremely rare beautiful native orchid blooms in a carefully protected small glass enclosure at center. A botanist and child lean close with quiet admiration, hands kept respectfully outside enclosure. The contrast of one precious exceptional specimen among many common plants communicates rarity and value. No labels, price tags, legendary animals or decorative jewels.
